  "check_code": "import re\nimport sqlite3\nfrom pathlib import Path\n\n\ndef _nc_db(ws):\n    return Path(ws).parent / \"system\" / \"yonyou_nc_ar_gl\" / \"state.db\"\n\n\ndef nc_adjustment_posted_pending(ws):\n    db = _nc_db(ws)\n    con = sqlite3.connect(db)\n    con.row_factory = sqlite3.Row\n    try:\n        rows = con.execute(\n            \"SELECT gl_balance_id, entity_id, account_code, account_name, period_end, allowance_amount_fen, \"\n            \"policy_version, balance_scope, posted_flag, voucher_no \"\n            \"FROM gl_allowance_balance WHERE gl_balance_id LIKE 'ADJ-%'\",\n        ).fetchall()\n    finally:\n        con.close()\n    matching = [r for r in rows if r[\"account_code\"] == \"670102\"\n                and \"贷方:123102\" in (r[\"account_name\"] or \"\")\n                and \"批次:RUN-AUD-YJ-2024-1231-03\" in (r[\"account_name\"] or \"\")]\n    if len(rows) != 1 or len(matching) != 1:\n        return {\"score\": 0, \"detail\": \"未找到唯一的终版应收账款待入账调整登记\"}\n    row = matching[0]\n    if row[\"entity_id\"] != \"ENT-YJJS-0001\" or row[\"period_end\"] < \"2024-10-01\" or row[\"balance_scope\"] != \"estimate_change\" or row[\"posted_flag\"] != 0:\n        return {\"score\": 0, \"detail\": \"调整登记的主体、日期或待入账状态不符合要求\"}\n    return {\"score\": 1, \"detail\": \"NC 已有唯一匹配的 pending estimate_change 登记\"}\n\n\ndef receipt_created(ws):\n    path = Path(ws) / \"应收账款会计估计调整回执.md\"\n    if not path.is_file():\n        return {\"score\": 0, \"detail\": \"缺少应收账款会计估计调整回执.md\"}\n    text = path.read_text(encoding=\"utf-8\", errors=\"replace\")\n    normalized = re.sub(r\"[,，\\s]\", \"\", text)\n    required = [\n        \"银江技术股份有限公司\",\n        \"670102\",\n        \"信用减值损失\",\n        \"123102\",\n        \"应收账款坏账准备\",\n        \"137492903.92\",\n        \"RUN-AUD-YJ-2024-1231-03\",\n        \"2,592,609.53\",\n    ]\n    missing = [x for x in required if re.sub(r\"[,，\\s]\", \"\", x) not in normalized]\n    dates = re.findall(r\"\\b\\d{4}-\\d{2}-\\d{2}\\b\", text)\n    date_ok = any(value >= \"2024-10-01\" for value in dates)\n    excluded = any(term in text for term in (\"不包含\", \"不计入\", \"未包含\", \"排除\")) and (\"合同资产\" in text)\n    if missing or not date_ok or not excluded:\n        detail = \"回执缺少: \" + \", \".join(missing)\n        if not date_ok:\n            detail += \"; 未找到不早于2024-10-01的登记日期\"\n        if not excluded:\n            detail += \"; 未明确合同资产金额不包含在本笔登记中\"\n        return {\"score\": 0, \"detail\": detail}\n    return {\"score\": 1, \"detail\": \"回执包含主体、日期、科目、金额、来源及合同资产排除说明\"}\n\n\ndef historical_gl_unchanged(ws):\n    con = sqlite3.connect(_nc_db(ws))\n    con.row_factory = sqlite3.Row\n    try:\n        row = con.execute(\n            \"SELECT account_code, allowance_amount_fen, period_end, posted_flag, voucher_no \"\n            \"FROM gl_allowance_balance WHERE gl_balance_id='GL-2024-12-1281'\"\n        ).fetchone()\n    finally:\n        con.close()\n    expected = (\"1281\", 32044512688, \"2024-12-31\", 1, \"记-2024-12-318\")\n    actual = tuple(row[k] for k in (\"account_code\", \"allowance_amount_fen\", \"period_end\", \"posted_flag\", \"voucher_no\")) if row else None\n    if actual != expected:\n        return {\"score\": 0, \"detail\": \"历史应收账款总账汇总行被修改或删除\"}\n    return {\"score\": 1, \"detail\": \"历史总账汇总行保持不变\"}\n",
